_meta.description: Rolling stock for Line 2B. Trains run now (Mandale to Chembur): six-car trains by BEML, from MMRDA's order MRS1 (2018; Press Information Bureau, 22 Nov 2018), which the news gives for Lines 2A, 2B and 7. 'in_service' is the section's opening paragraph. No source gives how many trains run on Line 2B. No image is sourced.

in_service.summary: Line 2B runs six-car trains built in India by BEML. They come from MMRDA's 2018 order for 378 cars for Lines 2A, 2B and 7. No source gives how many of them run on Line 2B.

procurement.value: The Government's release of 22 Nov 2018: 378 cars (63 trains of 6 cars) for Lines 2A, 2B and 7, Rs 3,015 crore
procurement.scope: Design, manufacture, supply, testing and commissioning of the cars, with spares and training
procurement.notes: Press Information Bureau (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, 22 Nov 2018) names Lines 2A, 2B and 7 for the 378 cars; BEML was the lowest of seven bidders. Free Press Journal (May 2019) names Lines 2A, 2B and 7 for the 378 cars; The Metro Rail Guy (Nov 2020) describes the order and its two additions for Lines 2A and 7 and does not name 2B. Swarajya (Oct 2025) names BEML for Line 2B's trains.

specs.label: The Government's figures at the award, 2018.
rows: 4 on each side of a car
specs.notes: Standard gauge and a car width of 3.2 m are reported at the order (Free Press Journal, May 2019).

facts.label: On Line 2B
facts.value: Six-car BEML trains, made in India, with regenerative braking, CCTV, charging points and space for bicycles

facts.label: Designed for
facts.value: Driverless running, regenerative braking, CCTV for riders and for watching the track ahead, full air conditioning

facts.label: The maker's description
facts.value: Six-car trains for unattended train operation (UTO), with a train control and management system (TCMS), built to the EN 45545 HL3 fire standard

facts.label: Supply
facts.value: At the award, supply was to begin in October 2020 and end in December 2022; the cars are built at BEML's factory in Bengaluru, with Hitachi for some designs

facts.label: Later orders
facts.value: BEML got two more orders under the same contract: 126 cars (21 trains, Rs 834 crore, August 2019) and 72 cars (12 trains, Rs 501 crore, November 2020), for 576 cars, 96 trains, in all. The Metro Rail Guy gives these for Lines 2A and 7
